content:
Between occupied seats, a run of empty seats can have length at most 2; otherwise the middle empty seat has no occupied neighbor. At the two ends, a run of empty seats can have length at most 1.

So if there are \(x\) occupied seats:
- There are \(x-1\) internal gaps, each allowing at most 2 empty seats.
- The two end gaps allow at most \(1+1=2\) empty seats.

Thus
\[
120-x \le 2(x-1)+2 = 2x.
\]
So
\[
120 \le 3x \quad\Rightarrow\quad x \ge 40.
\]

This is achievable with a pattern like:
\[
\_\ O\ \_\ _\ O\ \_\ _\ O\ \cdots\ O\ \_
\]
using 40 occupied seats.

\[
\boxed{40}
\]
